items.raw_excerpt: Wellington Airport says fog has caused several flight cancellations on Friday evening.
items.summary_en: Wellington Airport cancelled several flights on Friday evening because of heavy fog. Travelers should check with their airline before going to the airport. The fog is expected to clear later.
items.summary_ko: 웰링턴 공항이 금요일 저녁 짙은 안개 때문에 여러 항공편을 취소했습니다. 여행객은 공항에 가기 전에 항공사에 확인해야 합니다. 안개는 나중에 걷힐 것으로 보입니다.
items.title_en: Fog cancels flights at Wellington Airport
items.title_ko: 웰링턴 공항, 짙은 안개로 항공편 취소
items.title_original: Flights cancelled as fog hits Wellington Airport

items.raw_excerpt: Regent Taipei has received government approval to hire 37 Indonesian workers to help address labor shortages in Taiwan's hospitality industry, the Ministry of Labor (MOL) said Friday.
items.summary_en: Regent Taipei hotel got government approval to hire 37 Indonesian workers. They will help fix the labor shortage in Taiwan's hotels and restaurants. The Ministry of Labor announced this on Friday.
items.summary_ko: 리젠트 타이베이 호텔이 인도네시아 노동자 37명을 고용할 수 있는 정부 승인을 받았습니다. 이들은 대만 호텔과 음식점 업계의 인력 부족을 해소하는 데 도움이 될 예정입니다. 노동부가 금요일에 이 소식을 발표했습니다.
items.title_en: Regent Taipei hotel can hire 37 Indonesian workers
items.title_ko: 리젠트 타이베이 호텔, 인도네시아 직원 37명 고용 승인
items.title_original: Regent Taipei gets approval to hire 37 Indonesian workers

items.raw_excerpt: Brothers Darren and Steven Marshall are forced to leave the house they have called home since 1970.
items.summary_en: Two brothers must leave the house they have called home since 1970. Bailiffs evicted them after 55 years of living there.
items.summary_ko: 두 형제가 1970년부터 살아온 집을 떠나야 했습니다. 집행관이 55년 만에 그들을 집에서 쫓아냈습니다.
items.title_en: Brothers lose family home of 55 years
items.title_original: 'I felt sick as bailiffs evicted us from our home of 55 years'
